title: moan ward 06
author: No Name
content: 隔月開催される実験音楽イベント。 今回は東京より中村としまるをゲストに迎えた。 kmmo(Digital MTR, TV, Mobile Phone, Electric Guitar...) Shayne Bowden（Effecter, Tape Recorder, Mic...) 電子卓上音楽団 (Analogue synthesizer, sequencer, filter, CDJ...) 坂口壱彦 (Self-made Electric Devices...) 中村としまる (no-input mixing board) http://www.japanimprov.com/ [organiser] rhythm, deterra, attic associates [director] Keiji Tanaka (rhythm), Shayne Bowden (deterra) [art director] Shunsuke Onaka (attic associates), Tomoaki Hashimoto (attic associates) [PA] Greg Sullivan (Escalator Audio)
